location.heading: Where is the parking space?
location.intro: Put the pin on one disabled parking bay. Several bays next to each other? Add each one separately.
location.hint: Move the map until the pin sits exactly on the bay.
location.zoom_in: Zoom in further to place the pin precisely.
location.failed_text: We couldn't find a municipality in a supported country here. Move the map to the bay on the street, or try again.
location.nearby: A known parking space is {{distance}} metres away. Only add this one if it is a different bay.
location.my_location_failed: We couldn't determine your location. Move the map to the place yourself.

orientation.title: How is the bay laid out?
orientation.hint: Relative to the kerb. This determines how much room there is to get in and out.
orientation.required: Choose how the bay is laid out.

details.streetview: Not sure? View the place in Street View

under_sign.title: Is there a sub-sign?
under_sign.hint: The white sign below the blue sign, for example with a time limit or times.
under_sign.example: Example: a white sub-sign below the blue disabled parking sign
under_sign.required: Say whether there is a sub-sign.
under_sign.optional: Fill in what you know; everything below is optional.

note.title: Note
note.placeholder: For example how to find the parking space

after: Until then you can edit or withdraw it in My NIPKaart.
Once approved, the parking space is on the map for everyone.

submitted.title: Thank you, your parking space has been submitted
submitted.text: A moderator will review it soon. You'll get a notification once it's approved, or if something isn't right.

entry.guest_title: Sign in to add a parking space
entry.guest_text: That way moderators can review your submission and you can edit it later. Searching the map works without an account.
